name: Mira Vossell
source_profile:
Mira Vossell (NG) — Keeper of the Dockside Refuge

Sister Mira is a healer who operates Westbridge's modest charitable infirmary, having arrived in the settlement during the final years of the War of Broken Banners. She has devoted herself to caring for injured dockworkers, impoverished sailors, and travelers stranded by illness or misfortune.

A patient and practical woman, Mira has earned considerable respect among the waterfront's poorer inhabitants. She maintains a close working relationship with Tavish Hull, whose mutual-aid collections provide much of the Refuge's limited funding. She has also received occasional donations from wealthy merchants and members of the Emberhearth Kin.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 129 (source excerpt; may be partial)
